model: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, random_state=42), all 8 features + followup_score, stratified 80/20 split
notes: followup_score dominates (~68% importance) and nearly separates the classes; without it test accuracy is ~0.75, so the 0.93 may be inflated by leakage if followup_score is measured after diagnosis. Zeros in clinical columns were left as-is.
